counterexample_label: 反例：代理几何被错误标注为官方 native DWG
counterexample_lesson: Structurally similar path arrays must retain distinct proxy_paths_mm and official_native_dwg_paths_mm identities at the IFC write boundary.
reason: The first derived IFC consumed simplified proxy paths instead of official native WFB DWG paths. The blue drain rectangle is not present in the official DWG.
